name: rtl-vazirmatn-chat
description: Chrome extension: Vazirmatn font + automatic RTL for Persian paragraphs in AI chat UIs

scripts.check: node --check src/content.js && node --check src/background.js && node --check src/options.js && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const m=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('manifest.json','utf8'));if(m.manifest_version!==3)throw new Error('manifest_version must be 3');console.log('manifest ok, version', m.version)"
